theorems.name: Submission.lpf_pic_current_of_dominated_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (V : Set (Eucl Q)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (g : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (w : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl Q) n), AEMeasurable g μ → AEStronglyMeasurable w μ → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → ∃ h : Eucl P → ℝ, Integrable h μ ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, g x ∈ K → ‖w x‖ ≤ h x) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn V n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, S ω = ∫ x, w x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) n) (g x)) ∂μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
